proofMethod.viewport: Real fixed 320 CSS pixel layout and visual viewport.
proofMethod.textScale: Computed root font size asserted exactly 16px before and 32px after html { font-size: 200% !important }.
proofMethod.runtime: Every route loaded all same-origin application scripts and exposed its real runtime test contract before interaction.
proofMethod.actions: A reviewed family or singleton contract prepared required valid inputs and activated the authored form control or selector change.
proofMethod.result: The authored result surface became visible, contained rendered text, and the real application runtime published a fresh result after the observed action event.
proofMethod.privacy: Same-origin scripts ran normally; any attempted off-origin request, forbidden passive storage mutation, pre-consent analytics command, or result-action network write fails the proof. Full request envelopes and local/session storage mutations are recorded.
proofMethod.clipping: Every visible element rectangle and every direct non-whitespace text-node Range fragment was inspected recursively through light DOM and every open shadow root without a document-overflow early return.
proofMethod.artwork: The route-owned hero remained loaded, visible, and family-semantically labelled after result rendering.
